claims.claim: Q2 FY2027 revenue of $771.8M, 30% growth, Atlas growth near 29%, EA/other near 36% and raised guidance remain realized operating evidence; the September 29 Investor Day remains evidence-to-come.

factors.name: Atlas growth
factors.basis: Atlas growth near 29% supports cloud consumption execution.

risks.risk: Cloud consumption variability, hyperscaler competition and expectation sensitivity remain material.

contradictions.claim: Strong total growth coexists with uncertainty over Atlas acceleration.
contradictions.resolution: Treat current growth as realized while leaving future acceleration unproven.

unknowns.unknown: AI contribution to Atlas consumption and future Investor Day targets remain unknown until disclosed.

claims.claim: Broad current growth and raised guidance support execution, while durable AI monetization and future long-term targets must not be pre-counted.

factors.name: guidance execution
factors.basis: Raised FY2027 guidance accompanies broad reported growth.

risks.risk: AI narrative can outrun measurable consumption contribution.

unknowns.unknown: Durability of growth and measurable AI contribution remain unknown.
